muted-foreground.$description: core uses color.gray.500 here, which is 4.39:1 on muted and fails WCAG AA (4.5:1) for text. color.gray.600 is 6.87:1 on muted and 7.23:1 on background; see scripts/check-contrast.ts.

border.$description: core uses color.gray.200 here, which is 1.18:1 on background and fails the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (WCAG 1.4.11). color.gray.500 is 4.63:1; see scripts/check-contrast.ts.

input.$description: Same value as border, and the same fix; core uses color.gray.200 here too.

ring.$description: core uses color.primary.500 here, which is 2.65:1 on background and fails the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (WCAG 1.4.11). color.primary.600 is 3.92:1; see scripts/check-contrast.ts.

destructive.$description: core uses color.red.500 here, which only reaches 3.60:1 (3.76:1 with a pure white foreground) and fails WCAG AA (4.5:1) for text. color.red.600 is 4.83:1 with a white foreground; see scripts/check-contrast.ts.

destructive-foreground.$description: core uses color.gray.50 here. Pure white gives a little more margin on the darker destructive red above (4.83:1 vs. 4.62:1) and there is no #ffffff primitive to reference.
